g.text: 30 development attempts per model/controller; model error bars are fixed-checkpoint Wilson 95% intervals. Human rates pool repeated attempts from five people.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Speed dots condition on success; human successful lives include respawns. Starts, practice and budgets differ. Faster successful runs do not establish human-level reliability.
